en_how: Grass, a path, trees, a spinning save crystal and the hero sprite are drawn pixel by pixel on a 320×180 (portrait 180×320) canvas, Chinese text is written straight onto it at 12 px, then everything is scaled up by an integer with smoothing off; the camera never moves: a blue dialogue box types out in the field, a staggered-bar wipe cuts to battle, the menu cursor hops, the hero dashes in and slashes, the enemy blinks every other frame, a damage number bounces and the enemy vanishes row by row.
